source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 1960271 patch changes http?s to https? in AttachmentInfo.isAllowedURL. The former allows https and the misspelled htts but rejects plain http; the latter permits http and https. The surrounding URL.canParse check remains a separate gate. Fixed accepted code later narrows HTTP(S) attachment URLs to feed-message enclosures and separately handles UNC and EWS schemes. This historical regular-expression repair does not authorize every current HTTP attachment. A seven-case ECMAScript matrix checked only the two expressions; no Thunderbird attachment or network operation ran.
title: Put the optional marker on the intended HTTP scheme character
